name: figure-to-svg
description: Replicate raster figures and icons as clean, editable, hand-authored SVGs. Two skills: figure-to-svg (whole infographic -> master SVG via split/regenerate/slice/vectorize/compose + fresh-eyes review loop; also the lesson/feedback/digest knowledge verbs) and icon-to-svg (one icon image -> faithful hand-authored vector). Use to vectorize figures for papers and slides so wording, colors, and layout stay editable in PowerPoint via Insert SVG -> Convert to Shape.
